pillars-section.title: Four pillars built for admissions success

p1.title: 'School-specific strategy' informed by 230+ admissions
p1.problem: International school admissions are more than an English test — each school has its own evaluation rubric.
p1.label: Real admissions analytics:
p1.solution: Over years of coaching 230+ admitted students, we've systematically catalogued school-specific exam patterns and admission profiles (NLCS, SJA, KIS, Chadwick, and more). We chart a learning path tuned to your target school's priorities.

p2.title: A 99% admission rate backed by 'complete application strategy'
p2.problem: High test scores alone rarely reveal a student's full potential. Candidates must stand out on their own terms.
p2.label: Tailored application support:
p2.solution: Trinity preserves its 99% admission rate by translating each student's activities and story into the target school's educational philosophy. Interview prep and essays are fine-tuned so the student's strengths lead.

p3.title: 'Detailed diagnosis and learning roadmap' that converts to admission
p3.problem: We avoid vague preparation — learning direction is decided on objective metrics.
p3.label: Data-driven analysis:
p3.solution: Against 230+ admission cases, we benchmark each student's academic level. MAP Test, ISEE, and other skill-area data quantify strengths and gaps, driving a prioritized, efficient roadmap.

p4.title: 'All-in-One' support from application through post-admission
p4.problem: We prevent errors in the application package and plan for a smooth transition into school life.
p4.label: Structured guidance:
p4.solution: From recommendation letters to supporting documents, we deliver precision packaging. We also reinforce academic fundamentals before enrollment so students adjust smoothly to IB, AP and other curricula.

s1.title: Tailored initial consultation
s1.label: Baseline profile and learning style:
s1.body: We run a 1:1 baseline consultation based on the student's existing academic record to establish today's starting line.

s2.title: Objective skill diagnostic
s2.label: Standardized level test:
s2.body: We administer the official NWEA MAP Test plus a trial class to evaluate Writing and Speaking. The diagnostic output quantifies the student's current performance.

s3.title: Strategic goal setting
s3.label: In-depth consulting and school matching:
s3.body: Using the diagnostic, we align on target schools where the student can shine and build a concrete admissions plan.

s4.title: Tailored curriculum and schedule
s4.label: Best-fit class grouping:
s4.body: We assign the most effective setting — group classes, 1:1, or summer/winter intensives — based on the student's level and timeline.

s5.title: Close monitoring and performance sharing
s5.label: Regular curriculum and feedback system:
s5.body: Structured lessons combine with periodic NWEA MAP TEST mock exams. Progress data is shared transparently via parent feedback reports.

principle.title: For the growth of each student
principle.p1: Trinity respects each student's learning pace, disposition, and goals. Even within the same grade, no two students receive the same curriculum. We clarify the starting point through MAP diagnostics and read disposition via TPI (Trinity Profile Index) to propose a path that fits each learner.
principle.p2: At the center of our shield crest sit the T and cross, three stars, a crown, and a pennant. Scholarship, faith, integrity, and community — these four values form the foundation of Trinity's education.
